instrument: phrase-presence diff over the primary document
not_a_section_diff: Section attribution (Item 1A vs Item 7) is NOT OBSERVED: filing bodies are served from www.sec.gov, which answers 403 to this client. Only pre-declared phrases are tested, so language nobody declared in advance is invisible here.

phrases.note: Pre-registered phrase list for LIBRARIAN (collective agent module 3). A phrase is testable against a filing only if it was declared BEFORE that filing was published -- qt.librarian.check_declared_before refuses otherwise, and librarian_diff.py counts the refusals rather than skipping them quietly. Adding a phrase is free; it simply cannot be applied backwards. These phrases are canonical distress and disclosure language from auditing and reporting practice, deliberately NOT chosen by reading any particular company's filing.

selection_rule: deduped on (CIK, form) so share classes count once; open-thesis names first, then most recently filed. Not alphabetical.
